title: Preserve nonvalidating unresolved content references
api_or_output: Exact optional unresolved-reference callback, owned DOM provenance and conservative owner-wide loss refusal

acceptance.description: Implement verified EntityDeclared WFC versus VC content applicability using actual internal/external subset, PE-reference and first unread declaration provenance, standalone and active source state. Exact NCName/lexical identity/location; optional borrowed callback once in ordered text boundaries, bounded owned pending storage, all splits and surrogate/byte mapping, consumed counts/pause/resume/cancellation/fault cleanup and quotas. Old sinks refuse only new unresolved occurrences with XML.UnresolvedReferenceSinkRequired; capable sinks succeed with no diagnostic. Preserve declared expansions, resource denial, recursion, unparsed/external attribute errors and all existing event/model shapes.

Implement approved XmlUnresolvedReference record and nonnull read-only XmlDocument.UnresolvedReferences list with owned names/location/stable Parent/PreviousSibling/original ChildBoundary/Sequence. Actual DOM Parse/TryParse/Load succeeds without diagnostic and separates text around gaps. Original provenance survives mutation/detachment. Serializer/string/Stream/Save, aggregate GetTextContent, shallow/deep Clone and ImportNode refuse any unresolved source owner after existing argument/cancellation validation and before writes/BOM/destination mutation/copy allocation/traversal; clean sources keep prior behavior and may import into unresolved destination. Guard exact entrypoints and test forwarding APIs, stream no-write and destination no-mutation.

Independently authored actual parser/event/DOM/refusal models for exact original E13 bytes and paired contexts; all short splits/byte transports/pause/cancel/retention/quotas/old sink controls, unaffected previous identities preserved. Run relevant full correctness, approved additive API/compiled frozen model and ABI preservation, source/package consumers and original profile audit. Meaningful applicable allocations/benchmarks with MemoryDiagnoser and ShortRunJob at exact Git/source/generated child/runtime identities, source-reviewed counters-disabled preparation and explicit fresh exclusive host grant. Never repeat unchanged successful standalone observations or relax thresholds/options/runtime. Retain concise counts/metrics/hash/failure summaries only, inspect/remove raw artifacts, validate planning/ownership/diff; no model-only or reference-agreement conformance claims.

handoff.summary: Required ordered implementation of the verified contract; exact proposed additive record/member approved by independent review and coordinator. No implementation until active Core and DTD prerequisite owners are verified.
requests: Missing attribute/default value representations remain separate classified obligations; do not silently fabricate normalized values, misclassify VC as WFC or claim full corpus coverage. Report exact cases/required contract ownership if observed. Preserve forwarding APIs and test their real callees; request exact additional owned files before edits.

Additional ordered ownership requested: src/Xemele/Parsing/Dtd/Grammar/Parser/Lexer.cs, to track actual lexical PE references at BeginParameter, distinguish WFC from VC-only missing PE at ExpandParameter, retain first-unread-PE state and suppress subsequent entity/ATTLIST publication without changing frozen model shapes.

Additional ordered ownership requested: src/Xemele/Parsing/Core/XmlParserCore.Resources.cs, to pass standalone and inherited first-unread state into the external DTD parser and transfer lexical/read provenance back from its completed model.
